database_memories: ENSURE: CAST the AOV column to INTEGER in the final SELECT | CONTEXT: The AOV field in the order_metrics (or equivalent) result set is calculated as a decimal average by default, but the gold standard expects integer values | WHEN_TO_CHECK: Anytime you include AOV in a SELECT for reporting or comparison against the gold output | EXAMPLE_USAGE:
SELECT CAST(AOV AS INTEGER) AS AOV
FROM order_metrics;  -- returns decimals and causes mismatches
generic_memories: VERIFY: output numeric columns match the expected integer or decimal type | PRINCIPLE: Ensuring the data type of numeric results aligns with the specification prevents assertion failures when comparing to a gold standard or expected output | WHEN_TO_APPLY: Whenever an expression or aggregation yields a different numeric type (e.g., decimal) than what the output spec calls for (e.g., integer) | EXAMPLE_USAGE:
Correct: SELECT CAST(AVG(score) AS INTEGER) AS avg_score
Incorrect: SELECT AVG(score) AS avg_score  -- yields decimals that may not match tests
